name: Arch Scroll
description: Pinned scroll showcase where text sections scroll on the left while images reveal one by one on the right, with the page background shifting color between sections.
contents: Sections list, each with title, description, colored link button with leaf icon
Pinned image column with one image frame per section
behavior: Images reveal by clip-path wipe from bottom while the image position shifts
Page body background animates between section colors
Desktop pins the image column, screens 768px and below stack text and image per section with a parallax shift

Page background colors and text color
